prompt: Umbraco 17. Editors want to embed videos from our internal video platform (https://video.intranet.example.com/watch/{id}). It has no oEmbed API; the player URL is https://video.intranet.example.com/player?src={encoded watch url}. Add support for it in the Embed dialog.
expectations: The provider builds the markup from the pasted URL without calling an oEmbed endpoint
The pasted URL is encoded before being placed in the iframe (e.g. Uri.EscapeDataString and/or WebUtility.HtmlEncode)
The UrlSchemeRegex is anchored to the scheme and host (e.g. ^https?://video\.intranet\.example\.com/watch/)
The provider overrides/implements GetMarkupAsync(string, int?, int?, CancellationToken)
The provider is registered in an IComposer via builder.EmbedProviders()
If no buildable project is available, the agent does not claim the code was compiled or run
